candidate.background_need: Three rural communities in the Fictional Reedshore region (Finland) face seasonal visitor demand, limited public transport, and sensitive wetland habitats. Two tourism firms propose an eighteen-month low-impact route pilot; no ecological baseline or visitor survey exists.

objectives.description: Test whether accessible off-season routes can support local services without increasing habitat pressure.
Establish operational criteria for 'low-impact' metrics in the absence of existing ecological baseline data.

preliminary_activities.description: Conduct preliminary visitor traffic monitoring to estimate off-season demand patterns.
Collect empirical data on habitat disturbance signs (e.g., trampling, noise) at fixed monitoring points prior to defining thresholds.
Document current funding constraints and identify potential partners for the eighteen-month pilot period.

expected_results.description: Verified visitor traffic levels during off-season periods.
Empirical data on habitat disturbance signs collected for threshold definition.
Documented funding constraints and identified potential partners.

proposed_indicators.description: Number of visitors per route segment exceeding provisional threshold levels.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Counting visitor arrivals at designated checkpoints using manual logs and temporary sensors.

proposed_indicators.description: Percentage of habitat areas showing measurable disturbance signs (e.g., trampling, noise).
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Visual inspection and audio recording at fixed monitoring points.

proposed_indicators.description: Number of potential partners identified for the pilot period.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Reviewing partnership interest forms or preliminary agreements.

assumptions: Current transport limitations prevent year-round access, necessitating route testing.
Partner commitment levels are sufficient to proceed with the pilot despite missing funding conditions.
Expert consensus can reliably define 'low-impact' metrics without baseline data.
open_questions: What specific ecological thresholds constitute acceptable habitat pressure in this region?
Are partner commitments beyond the initial proposal confirmed for the full eighteen-month duration?
Will general funding research be sufficient to cover all costs if no official call conditions are defined?
